title: Baobab-Platform BuyerOrganisation domain identifiers, enumerations and resource
description: Gate ZB-01 initial publication (ADR-SHARED-008 SS5): the buyer-side counterparty a tenant trades with. Governed under the capability/v1 namespace registry's `customer` domain. This package defines vocabulary and the resource shape only; it mints no canonical Organisation ID and does not replace an engine-owned Customer/Business Partner record -- same boundary contracts/supplier-onboarding/v1 draws for suppliers.

buyerOrganisationId.description: Control Plane-minted opaque identifier for a BuyerOrganisation.

canonical_organisation_id.description: Reserved and nullable, mirroring contracts/supplier-onboarding/v1's canonical_organisation_id: no canonical Organisation ID authority exists yet (contracts/erp/v1/system-of-record.yaml keeps Organisation's canonical_owner unassigned).
